{"files": [{"content": """"Shared client for the Meta Model API."""
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from uuid import uuid4

import openai

from budget import BudgetedHttpClient, TRANSCRIBE_MODEL

logger: logging.Logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

BASE_URL: str = "https://api.meta.ai/v1"
DEFAULT_MODEL: str = "muse-spark-1.3"
DEFAULT_ENV_FILE: Path = Path(__file__).parent / ".env"
ENV_FILE: Path = DEFAULT_ENV_FILE
KEY_NAME: str = "MODEL_API_KEY"
PLACEHOLDER: str = "your-api-key-here"
PLACEHOLDERS: frozenset = frozenset({"your-api-key-here", "your-key-here"})


def read_key_from_env_file(path: Path = ENV_FILE) -> str | None:
    """Read MODEL_API_KEY from a .env file."""
    try:
        text: str = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    except OSError:
        return None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped: str = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if "=" not in line:
            continue
        key: str
        _: str
        value: str
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        if key.strip() != KEY_NAME:
            continue
        val: str = value.strip()
        if len(val) >= 2 and ((val[0] == '"' and val[-1] == '"') or (val[0] == "'" and val[-1] == "'")):
            val = val[1:-1].strip()
        if not val:
            return None
        return val
    return None


def _default_saved_key_path() -> Path:
    """Default path of the key saved by the setup page, outside the repository."""
    if os.name == "nt":
        local: str = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or ""
        if local:
            return Path(local) / "Blackout" / "api_key"
        return Path.home() / "Blackout" / "api_key"
    return Path.home() / ".blackout" / "api_key"


def saved_key_path() -> Path:
    """Path of the key saved by the setup page, outside the repository."""
    explicit: str = os.environ.get("BLACKOUT_KEY_FILE") or ""
    if explicit:
        candidate: Path = Path(explicit).expanduser()
        try:
            resolved: Path = candidate.resolve()
        except Exception:
            resolved = candidate.absolute()
        repo: Path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        try:
            inside: bool = resolved.is_relative_to(repo)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        except AttributeError:
            inside = str(resolved) == str(repo) or str(resolved).startswith(str(repo) + os.sep)
        except Exception:
            inside = False
        if inside:
            logger.warning("BLACKOUT_KEY_FILE points inside the repository; using the default key location instead")
            return _default_saved_key_path()
        return Path(explicit)
    return _default_saved_key_path()


def is_plausible_key(value: object) -> bool:
    """Whether a value could be a real key, without revealing anything."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return False
    if value in PLACEHOLDERS:
        return False
    if len(value) < 16 or len(value) > 512:
        return False
    return all(0x21 <= ord(char) <= 0x7E for char in value)


def save_key(value: str) -> None:
    """Save a key atomically with owner-only permissions where supported."""
    if not is_plausible_key(value):
        raise ValueError("invalid key format")
    path: Path = saved_key_path()
    parent: Path = path.parent
    temp: Path = parent / (".api_key." + uuid4().hex + ".tmp")
    created: bool = False
    try:
        parent_existed: bool = parent.is_dir()
        parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if os.name != "nt" and not parent_existed:
            os.chmod(parent, 0o700)
        descriptor: int = os.open(temp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        created = True
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(value + "\n")
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        if os.name != "nt":
            os.chmod(temp, 0o600)
        os.replace(temp, path)
        created = False
        if os.name != "nt":
            os.chmod(path, 0o600)
    except Exception:
        if created:
            try:
                temp.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        raise OSError("could not save key") from None


def read_saved_key() -> str | None:
    """Read the saved key if present and plausible."""
    try:
        value: str = saved_key_path().read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    except Exception:
        return None
    return value if is_plausible_key(value) else None


def delete_saved_key() -> bool:
    """Remove the saved key and report whether one existed."""
    path: Path = saved_key_path()
    existed: bool = False
    try:
        path.unlink()
        existed = True
    except FileNotFoundError:
        existed = False
    except OSError:
        existed = False
    try:
        for leftover in path.parent.glob(".api_key.*.tmp"):
            try:
                leftover.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    return existed


def _env_key() -> str | None:
    value: Optional[str] = os.environ.get(KEY_NAME)
    if value is not None and value != "" and value not in PLACEHOLDERS and is_plausible_key(value):
        return value
    return None


def _file_key() -> str | None:
    value: str | None = read_key_from_env_file(ENV_FILE)
    if value is not None and value != "" and value not in PLACEHOLDERS and is_plausible_key(value):
        return value
    return None


def load_api_key() -> str:
    """Load API key from env, then .env file, then the saved key file."""
    env_val: str | None = _env_key()
    if env_val is not None:
        return env_val
    if os.environ.get(KEY_NAME) == PLACEHOLDER:
        logger.warning("placeholder key in environment")
    file_val: str | None = _file_key()
    if file_val is not None:
        return file_val
    saved_val: str | None = read_saved_key()
    if saved_val is not None:
        return saved_val
    raise RuntimeError(f"MODEL_API_KEY is not set. Create a key at https://dev.meta.ai/api-keys/ , then run python start.py and paste it into the page, or put it in {ENV_FILE} as MODEL_API_KEY=...")


def key_source() -> str:
    """Where the effective key comes from, without returning the key."""
    if _env_key() is not None:
        return "environment"
    if _file_key() is not None:
        return "env_file"
    if read_saved_key() is not None:
        return "saved"
    return "none"


def create_client() -> openai.OpenAI:
    """Create an OpenAI SDK client with the budget guard."""
    return openai.OpenAI(base_url=BASE_URL, api_key=load_api_key(), http_client=BudgetedHttpClient())


def transcribe_wav(wav: bytes, languages: tuple[str, ...] = ("Mandarin Chinese", "English")) -> str:
    """Transcribe 16-bit mono WAV audio to text."""
    key: str = load_api_key()
    settings: dict[str, object] = {"mode": "PUSH_TO_TALK", "model": TRANSCRIBE_MODEL, "audioEncoding": "WAV", "languageBias": list(languages)}
    payload: str = json.dumps(settings)
    files: dict[str, object] = {"request": (None, payload, "application/json"), "audio": ("speech.wav", wav, "audio/wav")}
    headers: dict[str, str] = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}
    url: str = f"{BASE_URL}/asr/transcribe"
    with BudgetedHttpClient(timeout=120) as client:
        resp = client.post(url, files=files, headers=headers)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data: object = resp.json()
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("bad transcribe response")
    out: object = data.get("transcript")
    if not isinstance(out, str):
        raise ValueError("missing transcript")
    return out

import io

from app.main import app
from app.security import csp_for

SECRET: str = "FAKEKEY-do-not-leak-1234567890"
ORIGIN: dict = {"Origin": "http://127.0.0.1:8000"}


def local_client() -> TestClient:
    return TestClient(app, base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000", client=("127.0.0.1", 50000))


def models_payload(missing: bool = False) -> dict:
    ids: list = list(keys.REQUIRED_MODELS)
    if missing:
        ids = ids[:-1]
    return {"data": [{"id": item} for item in ids]}


class FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, status_code: int, payload: object = None, bad_json: bool = False) -> None:
        self.status_code: int = status_code
        self._payload: object = payload
        self._bad_json: bool = bad_json

    def json(self) -> object:
        if self._bad_json:
            raise ValueError("bad")
        return self._payload


def assert_no_secret(response: object) -> None:
    body: str = str(getattr(response, "text", ""))
    headers: str = str(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
    assert SECRET not in body
    assert SECRET[-8:] not in body
    assert SECRET not in headers
    assert SECRET[-8:] not in headers


def test_env_file_isolated_from_real_env(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert (tmp_path in muse_client.ENV_FILE.parents) is True
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        muse_client.load_api_key()


def test_save_read_delete(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    muse_client.save_key(SECRET)
    assert (muse_client.read_saved_key() == SECRET) is True
    assert (muse_client.load_api_key() == SECRET) is True
    assert muse_client.key_source() == "saved"
    leftovers: list = [item for item in tmp_path.iterdir() if item.name != "api_key" and "tmp" in item.name]
    assert leftovers == []
    if os.name != "nt":
        assert (muse_client.saved_key_path().stat().st_mode & 0o777) == 0o600
    assert muse_client.delete_saved_key() is True
    assert muse_client.read_saved_key() is None
    assert muse_client.delete_saved_key() is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", ["has space in it 123456", "line\nbreak-1234567890", "ctrl\x01value-1234567890", "short", "your-api-key-here", "your-key-here"])
def test_is_plausible_refuses(value: str) -> None:
    assert muse_client.is_plausible_key(value) is False


def test_load_order_and_source(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    env_file: Path = tmp_path / "sample.env"
    env_file.write_text("MODEL_API_KEY=envfilekey-1234567890\n", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "ENV_FILE", env_file)
    muse_client.save_key(SECRET)
    assert (muse_client.load_api_key() == "envfilekey-1234567890") is True
    assert muse_client.key_source() == "env_file"
    monkeypatch.setenv("MODEL_API_KEY", "envkey-123456789012")
    assert (muse_client.load_api_key() == "envkey-123456789012") is True
    assert muse_client.key_source() == "environment"
    monkeypatch.delenv("MODEL_API_KEY")
    env_file.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    assert (muse_client.load_api_key() == SECRET) is True
    assert muse_client.key_source() == "saved"


def test_setup_key_guards(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    remote = TestClient(app, client=("203.0.113.9", 50000))
    response = remote.post("/api/setup/key", headers=ORIGIN, json={"key": SECRET})
    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_local"
    client = local_client()
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", json={"key": SECRET})
    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "forbidden_origin"
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", headers={"Origin": "http://evil.example"}, json={"key": SECRET})
    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "forbidden_origin"
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", headers={**ORIGIN, "Content-Type": "text/plain"}, content=b"{}")
    assert response.status_code == 415
    monkeypatch.setenv("MODEL_API_KEY", SECRET)
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", headers=ORIGIN, json={"key": SECRET})
    assert response.status_code == 409
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "key_from_env"
    monkeypatch.delenv("MODEL_API_KEY")
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", headers=ORIGIN, json={"key": "bad key"})
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_key_format"
    assert_no_secret(response)


def test_setup_key_spoofed_host_rejected() -> None:
    client = local_client()
    response = client.post("/api/setup/key", headers={"Host": "testserver", "Origin": "http://testserver"}, json={"key": SECRET})
    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_local"

def test_setup_key_ok_saves(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:

def test_secret_never_in_responses_or_logs(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture) -> None:
    real_check = keys.check_key
    monkeypatch.setattr(keys, "check_key", lambda value: "ok")
    client = local_client()
    responses: list = [

def test_log_redaction_removes_secret() -> None:
    previous_factory = logging.getLogRecordFactory()
    keys.install_log_redaction()
    keys.install_log_redaction()
    keys.remember_secret(SECRET)
    keys.remember_secret("short")
    assert (keys.redact(f"a {SECRET} b") == "a [key] b") is True
    stream: io.StringIO = io.StringIO()
    handler: logging.Handler = logging.StreamHandler(stream)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(levelname)s:%(message)s"))
    test_logger: logging.Logger = logging.getLogger("blackout.test.redaction")
    old_level: int = test_logger.level
    old_propagate: bool = test_logger.propagate
    test_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    test_logger.propagate = False
    test_logger.addHandler(handler)
    try:
        test_logger.warning("x %s", SECRET)
        test_logger.warning(SECRET)
        try:
            raise RuntimeError(SECRET)
        except RuntimeError:
            test_logger.exception("oops")
        handler.flush()
        output: str = stream.getvalue()
        assert SECRET not in output
        assert SECRET[-8:] not in output
        assert "[key]" in output
    finally:
        test_logger.removeHandler(handler)
        test_logger.setLevel(old_level)
        test_logger.propagate = old_propagate
        logging.setLogRecordFactory(previous_factory)
        handler.close()

def test_resolve_stop_at(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    env_file: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    env_file.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.delenv("BLACKOUT_STOP_AT_USD", raising=False)
    assert budget._resolve_stop_at(env_file) == 10.0
    monkeypatch.setenv("BLACKOUT_STOP_AT_USD", "25")
    assert budget._resolve_stop_at(env_file) == 25.0
    monkeypatch.setenv("BLACKOUT_STOP_AT_USD", "999")

    env_file.write_text("BLACKOUT_STOP_AT_USD=33\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert budget._resolve_stop_at(env_file) == 33.0

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

import muse_client
from muse_client import BASE_URL, KEY_NAME, PLACEHOLDER, load_api_key, read_key_from_env_file, transcribe_wav


def _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def test_read_simple(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "MODEL_API_KEY=abc123-0123456789abcdef\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "abc123-0123456789abcdef"


def test_read_bom_quotes_spaces(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    p.write_bytes("\ufeffMODEL_API_KEY  =  \"secret-xyz-0123456789abcdef\"  \n".encode("utf-8"))
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "secret-xyz-0123456789abcdef"
    p2: Path = tmp_path / ".env2"
    _write(p2, "MODEL_API_KEY='quoted-key-0123456789abcdef'\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p2) == "quoted-key-0123456789abcdef"


def test_read_empty_returns_none(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "MODEL_API_KEY=\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) is None


def test_read_missing_returns_none(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert read_key_from_env_file(tmp_path / "nope.env") is None


def test_read_ignores_other_keys(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "OTHER=1\nMODEL_API_KEY=good-key-0123456789abcdef\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "good-key-0123456789abcdef"


def test_env_priority(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(KEY_NAME, "env-key-0123456789abcdef")
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: "file-key-0123456789abcdef")
    assert load_api_key() == "env-key-0123456789abcdef"


def test_placeholder_rejected(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.delenv(KEY_NAME, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: PLACEHOLDER)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
        load_api_key()
    msg: str = str(exc.value)
    assert msg.startswith("MODEL_API_KEY is not set")
    assert "https://dev.meta.ai/api-keys/" in msg
    assert ".env" in msg


def test_missing_key_message(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.delenv(KEY_NAME, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: None)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
        load_api_key()
    assert str(exc.value).startswith("MODEL_API_KEY is not set")
    assert "https://dev.meta.ai/api-keys/" in str(exc.value)


def test_file_key_used_when_env_has_placeholder(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(KEY_NAME, PLACEHOLDER)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: "file-key-0123456789abcdef")
